correctness.rationale: Exact characteristic polynomials are x(x^2-x-3)(x^2+x-1) and x(x+2)(x^3-2x^2-2x+2). Rational root isolations determine Perron roots and all competing moduli, yielding D_G(q)=(alpha+q)/(phi-q) and D_H(q)=(beta+q)/(2-q). Cross multiplication gives strictly positive intercept greater than 43/80 and q slope greater than 17/40 throughout q in [0,1/2]. Perron growth switches for every F in the nonempty interval (4/(beta+q),4/(alpha+q)). Complete graph-order sharpness follows from the triangle/paw/diamond/K4 classification, exact rational root bounds and endpoint-affinity comparisons. A standalone standard-library checker independently rebuilt all matrices and enumerated 19 connected labeled nonbipartite 4-vertex graphs and 30 available edge additions; the universal parameter inequality relies on the analytic proof, not numerics.

originality.rationale: The exact theorem concerns simultaneous strict increase of the Perron growth multiplier and decrease of the subdominant damping ratio on an open fecundity interval and the full self-retention interval 0<=q<=1/2. The entire no-example classification for connected already nonbipartite graphs on fewer than five vertices is proved, not inferred from name searches. Artzy-Randrup--Stone establishes network-cycle/Perron persistence but does not in its inspected full text give the opposing damping behavior. Stott et al. define damping without this extremal graph claim. Atay--Biyikoglu considers Laplacian synchronizability rather than the adjacency dispersal operator. The most relevant ecological Shima et al. full text was unavailable: an exact duplicate there or elsewhere cannot be ruled out and is a residual risk.
residual_risks: The full Shima--Noonburg--Phillips (2010) article, the most directly plausible prior source, was inaccessible; an equivalent example or broader statement could be hidden in its results or appendices.
Large graph-spectral perturbation literature may encode an equivalent five-vertex classification in other terminology; no uniqueness guarantee is asserted.
Relative spectral damping does not determine all finite-time or stochastic ecological outcomes.

value.rationale: The result isolates a structural conflict between two ecologically motivated invariants under the same physical transport law: an added corridor improves long-run invasion while worsening relative spectral relaxation. The conflict holds over a continuum of both retention ratios and fecundities and has a complete sharp minimum at five patches even if an odd cycle already exists. This is not merely a restated Perron monotonicity fact or a numerical single-parameter accident, and motivates balancing growth capacity with recovery of patch distribution. It does not assert stochastic persistence or management optimality.
